summary: JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, announcing via press release that it will report second quarter 2026 financial results before U.S. markets open on August 26, 2026. Management will host an earnings conference call the same day. The filing is a routine earnings date announcement containing no transactional terms, deal structure, board recommendations, or strategic actions. It is a standard notice of an upcoming financial results release and earnings call, with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital return events. What to watch: the earnings release on August 26 for operational and financial performance updates.
